column1: # Chained forward application of Function-typed params — the compose family
# a live miscompile: the whole-frame replay's flat window lost the source's
# paren structure, so `f (g x)` compiled the RET count error where the
# interpreter applies both fns). noteDynFrameReplay now declines a window
# holding MORE THAN ONE applicable value (Function-typed or Dynamic), so
# these rows are sound whole-program refusals with interpreter parity.
# Graduation = Stage G proper (general dynamic apply inside fn units:
# resolveDynamicApply routed into the fn-unit finish, trailingApply over
# frame-local fns, chained applies as consecutive OpCallDynamic in token
# order), at which point the ledger entries delete and the rows move into
def compose fn [[f:Function g:Function x:Integer] [Integer] [f (g x)]] compose ([a:Integer] => [a mul 2]) ([b:Integer] => [b add 3]) 4
column3: the canonical compose: outer param fn applied to the inner param fn's result

column3: self-composition — the same window with one fn value read twice
